segments.label: 비 오는 날 출근룩
en: Rain this afternoon? Don't wear suede today
01 Outerwear: skip wool — nylon anoraks and waxed cotton shed water
02 Easiest fix: rest the suede, wear rubber Chelsea boots instead
03 Hems: end trousers above the ankle — wet hems soak up water
Rewatch before the rain — Sources: KMA forecast, Vogue Korea

segments.label: 2개로 4가지 코디
en: Own just these 2 pieces? You can wear them 4 ways
Her: olive field jacket + black knit maxi skirt — hoodie, belt, or scarf
Him: red check shacket + cream corduroy pants — beanie, turtleneck, or vest
Formula: keep the 2 pieces, switch shoes, inner layer and accessories
